[[AS Saint-Etienne]] won '''Division 1 season 1966/1967''' of the [[Ligue de Football Professionnel|French Association Football League]] with 54 points.

Promoted from [[Ligue 2|Division 2]], who will play in [[French soccer Division 1 1967/1968|Division 1 season 1967/1968]]
* [[AC Ajaccio]]: Champion of [[Ligue 2|Division 2]]
* [[FC Metz]]: runner-up of [[Ligue 2|Division 2]]
* [[AS Aixoise]]: 4th place, [[SEC Bastia]] (3rd) stay in [[Ligue 2|Division 2]]

Merger at the end of the season
* [[Toulouse FC (1937)]] with [[Red Star Olympique]], become [[Red Star FC]]
